propositions: Seven decorated pytest fixtures return complete dict(os.environ) directly or nested, exposing unrelated ambient credentials when pytest renders fixture arguments during long traceback failures.
pytest saferepr serialization of fixture locals/arguments containing copied os.environ leaks arbitrary inherited secrets in default long traceback mode but not in short traceback mode.

Each of the seven fixtures must be refactored to return an explicit mutable allowlisted mapping containing only required PATH, state paths, and fixture-specific overrides rather than copying complete ambient environment.
Minimal environment testing (env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin) proves all fixture consumers and their tests pass without arbitrary ambient key dependencies, validating allowlist completeness.

An inserted synthetic sentinel in the first position of os.environ must render in long traceback output before and after fix, with the exact dict(os.environ) reversion returning the security oracle to RED state.
